meta.title: ASME B16.9 butt-welding fittings: centre-to-end of 90 deg / 45 deg long-radius and 90 deg short-radius elbows, straight tee run, concentric reducer length
meta.standard: ASME B16.9 (factory-made wrought butt-welding fittings), paywalled. Values below are quoted from public manufacturer / reference tables found by search and cross-checked; inch values are the standard's, mm = inch x 25.4 unless a source prints a rounded metric value.

sources.S8: Texas Flange, '90 deg Long Radius Elbow Dimensions' and '45 deg Long Radius Elbow Dimensions', https://texasflange.com/butt-weld-fittings/elbow-long-radius/ , https://texasflange.com/butt-weld-fittings/elbow-45-long-radius/ (search extract)
sources.S9: Wermac, 'Dimensions of butt-weld elbows / straight tees ASME B16.9', https://www.wermac.org/fittings/dim_elbows_c.html , https://wermac.org/fittings/dim_tees_eq.html (search extract)
sources.S10: Hardhat Engineer, 'Pipe elbow dimensions long/short radius in mm', https://hardhatengineer.com/pipe-elbow-dimensions-long-short-radius-elbow-dimensions-in-mm/ (search extract)
sources.S11: dodo FreeCAD workbench (oddtopus), tablez/Reduct_SCH-STD.csv column H, LGPL-3.0, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oddtopus/dodo/master/tablez/Reduct_SCH-STD.csv (downloaded, copy in data/)
sources.S12: Hardhat Engineer 'pipe reducer dimensions' / Wermac 'dim reducers' (search extract: 8x6 length 152 mm; NPS 4 reducers length 4 in)

rules.lr90: A = 1.5 x NPS (inch) for NPS >= 3/4 (S8, S9, S10: 'centre-to-end of an LR elbow is 1.5 x NPS'; NPS 1/2 is an exception at 1.50 in)
rules.sr90: A = 1.0 x NPS for NPS >= 1 (S9 extract: short radius centre-to-face equals the nominal pipe size)

meta.tolerance: B16.9 centre-to-end tolerance for NPS 2..8 is +/- 2 mm (S9 extract on the tee table).

negativeExample.what: dodo tablez/Elbow_SCH-STD.csv BendRadius = 0.75 x OD (NPS 6: 126.2 mm), not the B16.9 LR radius 228.6 mm
negativeExample.use: VC-PSC-05 failure case: a catalogue import that carries this radius as 'B16.9 LR' must be flagged PSC_CATALOG_DIM_MISMATCH by check_piping_catalog against the rule lr90.

notVerified: Caps (length E) and reducing tees: no second source found; grade C, not used.
